definitions.explanation: A container for keeping water hot, or an electric hot water dispenser.

examples.english: To keep hot water in the pot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧ポット⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: To make tea with an electric hot water pot.
The water in the pot has cooled down.

notes:
In Japanese, ポット most commonly refers to an electric hot water dispenser — a kitchen appliance found in nearly every Japanese home and office. Unlike in English, it does not usually refer to a cooking pot.

TYPES:
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧ポット: electric hot water dispenser (keeps water hot at a set temperature)
- ⟦{魔法瓶|まほうびん}→魔法瓶：17387_mahoubin⟧: vacuum flask/thermos (no electricity)
- コーヒーポット: coffee pot
- ティーポット: teapot

DIFFERENCE FROM ケトル:
- ケトル (kettle): boils water, then turns off
- ポット (pot): keeps water hot continuously at a set temperature

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ポットにお{湯|ゆ}を{入|い}れる: to fill the pot with hot water
- ポットのお{湯|ゆ}: hot water from the pot
